F1: The change added `r.log.Error` calls at lines 534/537, 554/557 and 576/579. They run on every batch, even the final empty one, and log the full ID list while `err` is always nil. The new one-minute ticker in `cleanup.go:77` makes these runs more frequent, so the ERROR logs will flood.
F2: The non-SQLite branch of the new `deleteByIDs` uses one placeholder per ID, and nothing caps the batch size. A large `cleanupjob_batchsize` will go over the MySQL, Postgres or MSSQL parameter limits and make every batch fail. The old single DELETE statement did not have this limit.
